title: Process Excellence Analyst
summary: A process excellence analyst improves how work gets done using Lean Six Sigma (methods to cut waste and errors): mapping processes, finding root causes, tracking SLA and KPI results and spotting tasks to automate. The role sits in a quality or transformation team in a BPO, global capability centre or plant and works with operations managers.
dailyDuties: Map current processes and find delays and rework
Run DMAIC improvement projects with operations teams
Analyse defects with fishbone, 5 whys and Pareto charts
Build and refresh SLA and KPI dashboards
Identify tasks that could be automated and size the savings
Facilitate kaizen workshops and track action items
Present project results to operations leaders
typicalTitles: Six Sigma Green Belt - Process Excellence

skills.expectation: Run Green Belt projects through the DMAIC steps (define, measure, analyse, improve, control)
Use value stream maps and kaizen to remove waste and delays
Map as-is and to-be processes with swimlane flowcharts
Find root causes with fishbone, 5 whys and Pareto analysis
Analyse process data in Minitab or Excel, including control charts and capability
Build SLA and KPI dashboards that operations leaders review
Clean and analyse operations data in Excel
Spot tasks fit for automation and size the benefit
Work with operations managers and clients to agree and sustain changes
Understand how RPA bots work when handing over automation ideas
Write the cost-benefit case for an improvement
Apply hypothesis tests and regression to process data
Present project results and train teams on new processes
